observations.reason: The actual official Doctoral Program Coordinators page expressly lists Operations Research and explains that each listed specialization has a coordinator for its doctoral candidates. This establishes a named doctoral Operations Research area, beyond a faculty research interest. It does not establish a separate Operations Research degree or department, or a renamed Operational Strategy field.

sources.note: Full substantive official page opened and read on 25 October 2026. Introductory paragraph links listed specializations directly to doctoral candidates and applicant consultation; Operations Research is an explicit specialization heading. No coordinator personal contact details collected.
